meta_title: Mosmos — the AI that gets better at working with you
meta_description: Say the goal and Mos takes it, handing the deep work to the Mon beside it. The process stays folded away; you get the result you can use. We'll tell you the moment it's ready.
hero_tagline:
The AI that gets better
at working with you
hero_sub:
Say the goal and Mos takes it.
The hard parts go to the Mon beside it, and only the result comes back.
hero_trust: You'll be the first to know
hero_cta: Be the first to meet Mos
world_island_label: The sky island where Mos lives
mos_line_idle: The doors aren't open yet. I'm getting things ready here.
mos_poke_1: Hello. Leave your name and I'll remember it.
mos_poke_2: That tickles. You'll be the first one I call.
mos_poke_3: This island is quiet for now. The Mon arrive soon.
mos_poke_4: I'll wait right here. No need to hurry.
consent_label: (Required) I agree to the collection and use of my personal data
consent_microcopy: Launch news, your first invite, and notes from the build — nothing else. Unsubscribe any time.
empathy_loss:
Getting AI to do the work
quietly became work of its own.
empathy_gain: Mosmos will take that part from here.
demo_title:
Mos takes the ask
and splits it among the right Mon
demo_chat_ai2: Your deck is ready. I folded the process away.
loop_eyebrow: A world where my AI grows up
loop_title: The more you use it, the more it grows
loop_lead:
You hand work over, what worked becomes yours,
and it comes back as a result that fits you better.
loop_kicker: Not a tool that empties out as you use it — an AI that grows alongside you.
founder_note: Hi — I'm building Mosmos. I'll handle the first invitations personally, one at a time, and I'd rather share the process honestly than show you a finished picture.
trust_care: We only take in as many people as we can genuinely look after.
trust_cta_title: First in line, when it's ready
recruit_title: Want to build Mosmos as an early member?
recruit_text: If you're curious, take a look.
recruit_cta: See how to join the early team
confirm_title:
You're in.
We'll send your invitation from the front of the line.
confirm_email_sent: We sent a welcome email — take a look in your inbox.
confirm_care: We're inviting a small group at a time. We want to hear each person's story properly.
confirm_next: From here, we'll send you notes from the build now and then.
confirm_world_tagline: Another me, in the digital world
confirm_mos_line: I've remembered your name. You'll be the first one I call.
survey_intro: Want an earlier invite? 30 seconds more — what you tell us sets the order.
survey_job_label: What kind of work do you do?
survey_ai_label: What do you mostly use AI for these days?
survey_job_other_label: Other — what kind of work do you do?
survey_task_other_label: Other — tell us what kind of task
survey_done: Thank you. We'll keep this in mind.
error_invalid_email: Please check the email address once more.
error_no_consent: Check the consent box and we'll sign you up right away.
error_duplicate: You're already with us. You'll hear from us first when it's ready.
error_ratelimit: A lot of requests came in at once. Please try again shortly.
error_generic: Something went wrong for a moment. Please try again shortly.
privacy_intro: Mosmos collects only the minimum information below, for waitlist registration.
privacy_purpose: To share launch news and the first invitation
privacy_consent: Without consent we don't store anything. You can withdraw consent at any time — contact us if you'd like your registration removed.
privacy_optional: Survey answers such as your role and current AI tasks are optional, and are used only to set the order of first invitations.
demo_req1_ask: Research this quarter's market and turn it into a deck
try_title:
Try it before
the doors open
try_lead: The real screens, shrunk down. Press around and you'll see how the four connect.
try_hint_hub: Bring in a Mon you need
try_hint_inventory: Star a Mon to keep it close
try_hint_studio: Switch the safeguards on and off
try_note_guard: Safeguards sit on the boundary, not on a port
hud_beat_state: Patrolling every 30 min · quiet right now
joy_lead: Set a few values and the tone and judgement follow. Change them and the next conversation reflects it.
joy_m1: Praise and encourage freely, in a bright register
joy_m2: Playful and easy, never over the line
joy_m3: Suggest the action before the plan
joy_mode_note: Buddy only talks. Manager hands work to Mon.
flow_title:
Name the goal,
Mos picks the rest
flow_lead: You do not attach Mon in advance. In Manager mode, Mos searches your Inventory and the Hub and uses whatever fits.
flow_s1_d: “Flag the risky parts of this contract.”
flow_s2_d: From your Inventory, or the Hub if you do not hold one
flow_s3_d: Mana comes off once the run has finished
flow_note: Mos hands the work over and the charge lands once, after it finishes. It moves with document length and how long the run takes.
watch_title: It does more than what you ask for
watch_lead: Work with a time of its own is scheduled. Work that depends on a condition is watched.
watch_beat_d: Write what to look out for as a sentence and it sweeps for it on an interval.
watch_beat_meta: Every 30 min · 09:00–22:00 · never wakes you at night
watch_memo_1: Tell me if anything in my inbox is urgent
watch_memo_2: Tell me when Mana drops below 200
watch_memo_3: Tell me if yesterday's handover still isn't done
watch_memo_4: Give me a line if a competitor's page changes
watch_cron_d: Work with a fixed hour is booked. Unlike a patrol, it checks no condition.
map_lead: No screen does everything. The boundaries are drawn on purpose, so you always know which one to open.
map_monitor_d: Mos's state, today's flow and Mana in one place. Schedules and patrols are switched on here too.
map_hub_d: The registry of available capability. Mos searches it and uses what fits the goal.
map_hub_n: Not a place to stash things
map_inventory_d: The Mon and Mon Skills you hold. Holding them costs no Mana.
map_storage_d: Where the documents, tables and bundles a Mon made live. Kept the moment they are made.
map_studio_d: Assemble a Mon, and write a Mon Skill as a document. Publishing has to pass a check.
rev_title: Human reviews are only half of it
rev_lead: The record left by the Mos that actually handed work to it sits beside the human write-ups.
rev_mos_d: Not human write-ups — what the Mos that actually gave this Mon work reported back
rev_m2: Returned it in the format asked for
rev_mos_note: “It rarely misses a clause in Korean contracts. For English ones it was better paired with another Mon for standard-wording checks.”
rev_p1: “I nearly missed an auto-renewal clause and it caught it first. About 30 a run, so it is easy to keep using.”
rev_p2: “English contracts are still weak. Korean is accurate.”
